characters.name: Sára
characters.tag_prompt: child, brown hair, long hair, witch hat, witch costume, purple dress, striped thighhighs, holding broom, pumpkin basket
characters.desc_en: Sara, a brave 11-year-old girl dressed as a little witch with a pointy hat, purple dress and striped socks, holding a broom and a pumpkin-shaped basket

characters.name: Tínek
characters.tag_prompt: black cat, kitten, big yellow eyes, scared
characters.desc_en: Tinek, a very timid little black kitten with huge yellow eyes

characters.name: Dýňový král
characters.tag_prompt: (pumpkin head:1.4), (jack-o'-lantern head:1.3), tall, giant, cloak, autumn leaves cloak, glowing eyes, no face
characters.desc_en: the Pumpkin King, a giant figure with a glowing carved jack-o'-lantern for a head and a cloak of autumn leaves

locations.tag_prompt: outdoors, night, forest, full moon, fog, jack-o'-lantern, halloween, twisted trees
locations.desc_en: A Halloween forest at night, full moon, fog creeping over the ground, twisted trees like clawed hands, glowing carved pumpkins everywhere.

locations.tag_prompt: outdoors, night, forest clearing, glowing mushrooms, halloween, fog
locations.desc_en: A forest clearing surrounded by glowing mushrooms.

panels.scene_en: a Halloween forest at night with a full moon, fog and glowing carved pumpkins
Sara walks cheerfully with her broom and pumpkin basket, the black kitten peeks out of the basket with wide eyes

bubbles.speaker: sara
bubbles.text: Neboj se, Tínku! Dneska je Halloween, všechna strašidla jsou přece jenom převlečení sousedé… nebo ne?

panels.scene_en: close-up of the little black kitten trembling inside the pumpkin basket, only ears and huge eyes showing

bubbles.speaker: tinek
bubbles.translation: A co byl ten hrozný zvuk za námi?!

panels.scene_en: in a clearing ringed with glowing mushrooms stands the giant Pumpkin King holding a huge sack of sweets
the Pumpkin King towers over Sara laughing spookily, the kitten has leapt onto her witch hat and covers her eyes with his paws

bubbles.speaker: kral
bubbles.text: Muuuhahaha! Kdo se odvažuje žádat o sladkosti v mé noci?!

panels.scene_en: Sara lifts the kitten off her hat and bravely holds out her basket

bubbles.speaker: sara
bubbles.text: Koledu, nebo vám něco provedeme! A můj kocour umí strašidelně prskat!

panels.scene_en: close-up of the black kitten puffing out his chest and hissing as bravely as he can
the Pumpkin King laughs warmly and drops a giant lollipop into Sara's basket

bubbles.speaker: kral
bubbles.text: To byl ale strašidelný kocour! Tady máte pořádnou odměnu! Šťastný Halloween!
